# 1 Enoch Chapter 40 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**40:1** Then I saw an innumerable multitude — thousands upon thousands, tens of thousands upon tens of thousands — standing before the glory of the Lord of Spirits.

**40:2** On the four sides of the Lord of Spirits I noticed four special beings, unlike those who stand guard without ever sleeping. My angelic guide told me their names and revealed hidden truths to me.

**40:3** I heard the voices of those four beings as they offered praise before the Lord of glory.

**40:4** The first voice blessed the Lord of Spirits forever and ever.

**40:5** The second I heard blessing the Elect One and the chosen ones who belong to the Lord of Spirits.

**40:6** The third I heard praying and interceding for all the people who live on the earth, calling on the name of the Lord of Spirits.

**40:7** The fourth I heard driving back the accusers, refusing to let them come before the Lord of Spirits to bring charges against the people of the earth.

**40:8** I asked my angelic guide — the angel of peace who had shown me everything hidden — "Who are these four beings I have seen and heard, whose words I have written down?"

**40:9** He replied: "The first is Michael — full of mercy and patience. The second is Raphael, who watches over all the diseases and injuries that afflict humanity. The third is Gabriel, who rules over all powers. And the fourth, who watches over repentance and the hope of those who will receive eternal life, is called Phanuel."

**40:10** These are the four angels of the Lord of Spirits — the four voices I heard in those days.

---

*PNEUMA notes: This chapter is foundational for later Jewish and Christian angelology. The four archangels — Michael, Raphael, Gabriel, Phanuel — are assigned cosmic portfolios. Notably, one archangel's task is to repel satanic accusers (v. 7), anticipating Rev 12:10. Phanuel never appears in canonical scripture but is prominent in 1 Enoch.*
